instance.selection: Use target/environment mapping in owner SKILL; never enumerate unrelated profiles or silently fall back.
instance.currentVersion: unknown; historical values are not runtime evidence
instance.addressEvidence: Owner SKILL.md environment tables are the address SSOT; credential variables and exceptions in auth.nativeCredentialPath are selected-instance constraints.

auth.nativeCredentialPath: Official oci --profile oci-a4x-us-prod, ~/.oci/config and protected key referenced by selected profile; tenancy/user/fingerprint metadata only.
auth.missingCredentialWorkflow: Official oci setup config under authorized setup creates API keys; human uploads public key to correct tenancy user. Browser session authenticate only if explicitly selected and supported; never read private key.
auth.subjectAndResourcePermissionVerification: Match configured user/tenancy to Console metadata; oci iam user get --user-id <selected-user> --profile <target> when permitted; authorized compartment resource read. No STS-style universal caller probe assumed.
auth.issuanceConsumptionRevocation: API signing key revoke by user Console API Keys; security-token auth expiry/refresh separate from key deletion. Compartment IAM governs each resource.
auth.credentialHandling: Private injection only; never print/store secrets in repository, command arguments, chat or receipts. Discovery itself performs no login/token creation.

nativeRoute.business: Owner SKILL + version-matched official CLI/API documentation
nativeRoute.loginRecovery: web-access for human web interaction; official CLI only where explicitly documented
nativeRoute.refresh: platform-onboarding only for concrete auth/version/interface drift
nativeRoute.adapterStatus: delegated contract only; no new runnable provider or full API mirror implemented

referenceSources.use: authentication discovery; match actual deployed version before business calls
referenceSources.limitation: Official documentation does not prove instance compatibility.

versionPolicy.probe: oci --version; hosted APIs versioned per service, selected realm/region. Exact API key fingerprint/user and tenancy validated, not profile name alone.
versionPolicy.compatibility: Unknown deployment version requires non-mutating capability evidence before business usage; do not promote latest upstream docs to deployed compatibility.

verification.scope: Owner repository contract and primary documentation research only. No credential inspection, login, token issuance/revocation or online business calls.
pendingReasons: Target deployment version, selected subject and exact resource permissions have not been runtime verified.
Token/login workflow needs independently authorized selected-instance validation; no runnable unified provider is claimed.
